description: Rewrite the daemon (cmd/sshcustomd/main.go) to remove transparent proxy, iptables, DNS forwarder, and originalDst code. Add tun2proxy process management, SSH local port forward for udpgw (127.0.0.1:7300), and tun_setup.sh script invocation. Simplify Config struct to match new architecture. Keep all SSH transport chain, SSHPool, SOCKS5, WebUI/API, lifecycle, VPN Chain, and profile management code intact.
steps: Delete cmd/sshcustomd/dnsforward.go (DNS forwarder no longer needed - tun2proxy --dns virtual handles DNS)
Delete cmd/sshcustomd/originaldst_linux.go and cmd/sshcustomd/originaldst_unsupported.go (no SO_ORIGINAL_DST needed)
Delete internal/iptables/iptables.go (the entire package - tun2proxy --setup handles routing)
In cmd/sshcustomd/main.go: Remove the import of 'github.com/GoodyOG/SSHCustom_Magisk/internal/iptables'
In cmd/sshcustomd/main.go: Remove the TransparentProxy struct field from Config and all transparent_proxy JSON config fields
In cmd/sshcustomd/main.go: Add a Tunnel struct to Config: { Enabled bool, Mode string, UDPGWPort int } with json tags tunnel.enabled, tunnel.mode, tunnel.udpgw_port

In cmd/sshcustomd/main.go: Remove the startTransparentIfEnabled function, handleTransparentConn function, transparentAddr function, applyTransparentRules function, cleanupTransparentRules function, iptablesCfgFromConfig function
In cmd/sshcustomd/main.go: Remove the startDNSForwarder call and stopDNS variable from connectionManager

In cmd/sshcustomd/main.go: Remove all State fields related to transparent proxy: TransparentEnabled, TransparentAddr, TransparentRunning, TransparentApplied and their references in Snapshot() and State initialization

In cmd/sshcustomd/main.go: Add a startUDPGWForward function that listens on 127.0.0.1:7300 (configurable via cfg.Tunnel.UDPGWPort), accepts TCP connections, opens an SSH direct-tcpip channel to 127.0.0.1:7300 on the server via pool.Dial(), and pipes data bidirectionally. Returns a cleanup func

In cmd/sshcustomd/main.go: Add a tun2proxy process manager: startTun2Proxy(ctx, cfg) (func(), error) that execs the binary at <workdir>/bin/tun2proxy with args: --device tun_sshc --proxy socks5://127.0.0.1:1080 --dns virtual --dns-addr 8.8.8.8 --udpgw-server 127.0.0.1:7300 --udpgw-keepalive 25 --udp-timeout 30 --fwmark 2 --setup --bypass 10.0.0.0/8 --bypass 172.16.0.0/12 --bypass 192.168.0.0/16 --bypass 127.0.0.0/8 --daemonize. Returns stop func that kills the process and cleans up
In cmd/sshcustomd/main.go: Add a tun_setup.sh caller: callTunSetup(workDir, action string) error that runs <workdir>/scripts/tun_setup.sh start|stop

In connectionManager: After SSH auth succeeds and SOCKS5 is started, call startUDPGWForward, then callTunSetup(workDir, 'start'), then startTun2Proxy. On cleanup (stopActive), stop tun2proxy, call callTunSetup(workDir, 'stop'), stop udpgw forward
In stopTunnel: Call net_clean.sh AND tun_setup.sh stop for cleanup
Update configSummary and apiCapabilities to reflect new tunnel architecture (remove transparent_proxy references, add tunnel info)

Keep ALL of: SSH transport chain (attemptSSHAuth, openPreparedSSHConn, attemptTransport, dialTCPResolved, etc), SSHPool and all pool methods, SOCKS5 listener and handler, WebUI/API routes, profile management, VPN Chain API endpoints, metrics sampler, lifecycle management (startTunnel/stopTunnel), State and its methods
Add State fields: TunProxyRunning bool, UDPGWRunning bool (with json tags and Snapshot() entries)
acceptance_criteria: go build ./cmd/sshcustomd/ compiles without errors for linux/arm64 and linux/arm
go test ./... passes (update main_test.go if needed to remove references to deleted functions)
No references to 'iptables' package import remain in cmd/sshcustomd/
No references to originalDst, handleTransparentConn, startDNSForwarder remain in cmd/sshcustomd/
New functions startUDPGWForward, startTun2Proxy, callTunSetup exist and are called in connectionManager
